features.name: supplied_log_length
features.definition: What is the supplied log-transformed length value for the discussion?
features.spec: Use the supplied log_length column as is: pd.to_numeric(df['log_length'], errors='coerce'). Missing or non-numeric values give null. Do not recompute, rescale or change the log base.

h0: supplied_log_length has no association with the likelihood that the OP changed their view (coefficient = 0).
h1: Higher supplied_log_length is associated with a higher likelihood of the OP changing their view (coefficient > 0).
note: log_length is used as supplied; its construction, source text, log base and timing are undocumented. It is not equated with argument word count and was not reconstructed. It may include later text or outcome announcements, so contamination/timing risk exists. The association is descriptive, not causal. The OLS on binary delta is a linear probability model.
